results.title: South Jersey Counties (SeayK)
results.description: This data set is a spatial representation of counties in New Jersey developed by the NJ Office of Information Technology, Office of GIS (NJOGIS) in NJ State Plane Coordinate System (NAD83). It is not a survey document and must not be used as such. The polygons delineated in this data set do not represent legal boundaries. This data set improves upon previous versions of county boundaries through the integration of coincident features from several high quality source data sets, as a component of the NJOGIS statewide Parcels Normalization Project concluded in March 2010. Updates continue to be made as necessary.
results.snippet: To provide basic jurisdictional information. This data set was developed to produce the most accurate delineation of county boundaries achievable from existing data sources.

results.name: OBC_Analysis_Map_NJ
results.title: OBC Analysis Map NJ - TASK 5
results.description:
This feature layer was developed for the New Jersey Working Waterfronts analysis to evaluate the spatial overlap between working waterfront parcels and Overburdened Communities (OBC) and adjacent communities using the current NJDEP Environmental Justice (EJ) Map data.

The analysis includes working waterfront parcels within the following 13 New Jersey counties: Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Middlesex, Union, Monmouth, Ocean, Atlantic, Cape May, Camden, Cumberland, Gloucester, and Salem.

Working waterfront facilities classified as Military Installation, Other Water-Dependent, and WWTP were excluded from the analysis.

Where multiple working waterfront facilities were associated with the same PAMS_PIN, a single parcel polygon was retained rather than creating duplicate parcel geometries. Information for all facilities associated with the parcel was preserved in the parcel attributes. These fields include Facility Count, Facility Names, Facility Addresses, and Working Waterfront Use Types.

The NJDEP Environmental Justice layer was filtered to the 13 study counties. Block groups meeting Overburdened Community criteria—including Low Income, Minority, Limited English, and combinations of these criteria—were classified as OBC. Block groups identified as Adjacent were maintained separately for evaluating adjacent communities.
tags: Bloustein School of Planning and Public Policy
results.snippet: Working waterfront parcels in NJ's 13 working waterfront counties overlaid with NJDEP Overburdened Community (OBC) and Adjacent block groups, showing where the two overlap (194 of 665 parcels).

results.name: Voting_Wards
results.title: Voting Wards
results.description: This dataset contains polygons displaying the Ward boundaries within the counties in the state of New Jersey. Remington & Vernick Engineers computer-generated and currently maintains, all or in part, the ward/election maps for eleven (11) New Jersey County Boards of Election utilizing AutoCAD software and Esri ArcGIS software applications. We will utilize and reference these resources along with GIS resources available through local, county, state and federal sources, including, but not limited tax assessment parcel data. We will use these resources to create, update, maintain and verify the State-wide GIS dataset comprised of polygon shape files representing the current ward boundaries and election district boundaries for all constituent municipalities in the twenty-one (21) counties in the state of New Jersey.
